messages:
Ivy: heads-up — preflight hit a blocker during staged promote. deploy-bot failed artifact verification for `search-indexer`. checksum mismatch on manifest vs blob. anyone available?

deploy-bot: Promote blocked: search-indexer@canary-20260330 -> manifest digest mismatch. expected manifest sha256:aa3f... observed manifest sha256:bb4c...

Ben: weird. build #11022 uploaded manifest and blobs at 21:10 UTC. registry returned 201. later verify shows different manifest digest; blobs still present.

ci-bot: Build 11022: status=success. Uploader shows PUT /manifests returned 201. Subsequent HEAD of manifest returned 404 -> then a different manifest id appeared. Possible race between push and indexer GC.

Ivy: Immediate plan: pin canary to last-known-good image digest from previous successful smoke (sha256:aa3f9c88deadbeef) and re-run smoke tests. If smoke passes, keep a manual hold and escalate infra.

Ben: Agree. Also start a rebuild with NO_REMOTE_CACHE to force fresh manifest generation. If rebuild produces same manifest as observed (bb4c...), we'll need to invalidate old manifest and reconcile tags.

Ivy: Running pin now:
```
deploybot promote --service search-indexer --image search-indexer@sha256:aa3f9c88deadbeef --env canary --reason "pin-manifest-mismatch" --notify slack:eng-releases
```

deploy-bot: Promotion applied -> search-indexer@sha256:aa3f9c88deadbeef promoted to canary.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild pipeline #11025 with NO_REMOTE_CACHE=1. status: running.

Ben: Release-manager: applying manual release hold. We shouldn't cut while registry manifest state is flapping.

release-manager: Hold applied. Notifying product + infra. Adding a 1h change window to audit registry indexer and manifest GC.

Ivy: Running quick smoke: endpoint check, index health probe, bulk-reindex dry-run.

ci-bot: Smoke #11026: endpoint=pass, index-health=pass, reindex-dryrun=pass.

Ivy: Canary looks healthy on the pinned digest.

infra-oncall: Investigating. Looks like concurrent tag re-assignment during a registry tag-consolidation job caused a transient manifest rewrite. The indexer orphaned the original manifest reference which allowed a recreated manifest to appear with a new digest. We'll pause consolidation and roll a fix. Filing INF-1822.

Ben: Rebuild #11025 completed. It produced the original expected manifest sha256:aa3f9c88deadbeef. So rebuild matched pinned digest, good.

infra-oncall: Root cause: tag-consolidation job ran while a push was finalizing -> race. Mitigation: add a push-finalization lock, and make consolidation check manifest creation time and uploader ID before rewriting tags. Also add deploybot pre-promote manifest HEAD vs local computed check (2 retries).

release-manager: INF-1822 created: "Registry tag consolidation race -> manifest rewrite and checksum mismatch during promote" assigned to infra. ETA: patch in next off-peak window.

Ivy: Added release notes entry: "Canary paused briefly due to registry manifest reconciliation race; pinned to last-good digest and verified by rebuild; no customer impact."

Ben: After infra patch, we should run a smoke-promote test in the next change window to validate.

release-manager: Hold removed at 22:23 UTC. Proceeding with controlled promotes. We'll monitor for 45m and then proceed with the cut if stable. :thumbsup:
